- document:
  - navigation:

    - radio "Math" [checked]
    - radio "Coding"
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "A visual, interactive tutor, not a cheating machine" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Unlike other AI chatbots and homework help tools, Koji never just gives you the answer. He ensures you actually understand math.
  - paragraph: You learn with Koji on a shared interactive canvas. He asks guiding questions, sketches on your screen, gives hints, and provides visual help.
  - paragraph: Like the best human tutors, he gets to the heart of where you’re getting stuck, and works with you until you can solve hard problems yourself.
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "Adapts to exactly where you are" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Koji tracks what you’ve mastered and what you’ve missed, then builds your learning plan around the gaps.
  - paragraph: He gets you caught up on any shaky fundamentals, and personalizes your practice and review sessions to optimize your learning.
  - paragraph: He accelerates your learning plan when you’re ready, and slows down when you need it.
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "Real-time progress tracking & analysis" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Visual dashboards make it easy to see what clicked, what’s still difficult, and what to do next.
  - paragraph: Parents and learners also receive regular notifications with an overview of completed lessons, performance on mastery assessments, learning strengths, and areas that need more practice.
  - heading "Effective and trusted" [level=2]
  - group "1 / 3":
    - img "Koji offering to try another approach in a lesson chat, above a prompt reading “How can I help?”"
    - heading "Lesson interventions" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Koji provides instant, one-on-one help whenever you’re stuck, just like an expert sitting right next to you.
    - paragraph: Get guidance, alternative explanations, or hints, using voice or chat.
  - group "2 / 3":
    - img "A lesson plan headed “Let’s build up a few skills first”, listing distance skills marked as made for the learner"
    - heading "Mastery assessments" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Koji makes sure you understand every concept with regular assessments. If you come up short, he creates targeted practice to get you back on track.
  - group "3 / 3":
    - link "kidSAFE COPPA Certified seal":
      - /url: https://kidsafe.com/member/brilliant
    - heading "kidSAFE CERTIFIED" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Brilliant is independently certified to meet strict U.S. standards for kids’ online privacy and safety.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Brilliant is a member in the kidSAFE Seal Program. To learn more, click on the seal or go to
      - link "www.kidsafe.com":
        - /url: https://www.kidsafe.com/
      - text: .

  - img "A child using a tablet at a kitchen counter while an adult prepares food in the background"
  - heading "Always on your schedule" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Say goodbye to the chore of finding a tutor, driving to sessions, and fitting another thing into your schedule. Koji is there Sunday night before the test, Saturday morning for fun, and the quiet 20 minutes before dinner.
  - paragraph: Get a year of tutoring for the price of a few in-person sessions.
  - img "Aerial view of a university campus with historic brick buildings"
  - heading "Built by top learning experts" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Our curriculum is crafted by award-winning teachers, subject-matter experts, and learning designers from top institutions.
  - img "MIT"
  - img "Harvard University"
  - img "Stanford University"
  - img "Cornell University"
  - img "Caltech"
  - img "Students working through Brilliant lessons on laptops in a classroom"
  - heading "Trusted by thousands of schools" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Every student gets an interactive, personalized learning program – one that sees what they’re doing, gives custom feedback, and assesses for mastery. It fits into your classroom, or as homework.
  - paragraph: Free for individual classrooms. District pricing available on request.
  - paragraph:
    - link "See how schools use Brilliant →":
      - /url: /educators/?from=brilliant
  - region "Testimonials":
    - heading "Students, parents, and teachers love us" [level=2]
    - group "1 of 5":
      - paragraph: She’ll get stuck on a problem and then yell, ‘Never mind, Mom, I got it!’ How great is that?
      - img "Arianne"
      - paragraph: Arianne
      - paragraph: Parent of 10 year old
    - group "2 of 5":
      - paragraph: I didn’t get the slope unit in class, but it finally clicked after talking to Koji for a few minutes!
      - img "Eliza"
      - paragraph: Eliza
      - paragraph: 7th grader
    - group "3 of 5":
      - paragraph: It’s been a win-win. My son’s grades are up and he doesn’t complain about studying with Brilliant.
      - img "Hana"

      - paragraph: Parent of 16 year old
    - group "4 of 5":

      - img "Tyler"
